description:
Edit Kubernetes secrets with decoded values: the plugin decodes base64,
opens a clean YAML view in your editor, and re-encodes and applies on save.

Features:
- Multi-line values as YAML block scalars, JSON pretty-printed, binary preserved
- Change summary and confirmation showing the target context
- Reopens the editor on invalid YAML or API validation errors; edits never lost
- TLS cert/key validation and certificate summary before applying
- Warns about Helm/Argo CD/Flux/operator-managed secrets
- Shows the workloads using a secret and can restart them
- Non-interactive edits, secret creation, server-side dry runs, fzf picker
- Rich tab completion with descriptions
- Plaintext kept in RAM (/dev/shm on Linux) and wiped on exit or signals
